0.description: Killing a Felforged player on a Normal Hero will have a % chance to drop Fel Blood while leveling, and a 100% chance to drop Fel Blood at 60 that is using level appropriate gear.
Killing a Felforged player on a Normal Hero will now award loot based on their level and ilvl.
Felforged Challenge completions are now only announced to the Twisting Nether.
Corrected an issue where Perilous instead only granted experience in Honorable Combat areas. Woops.
Corrected an issue where Contender had awkward group interactions.
Corrected an issue where Perilous had awkward group interactions.
Azzazel now clarifies that higher tier challenges grant significantly higher rewards than those of the previous tier.

Felforged Challenges now reset and persist through death, greatly reducing the amount of downtime between playthroughs. You can still abandon these challenges as you have been able to in the past by dropping the quest.
The error message given when you attempt to invite a Felforged player and have a challenge count/tier mismatch is now also sent to the player you are inviting, with information about the inviter.
The error message given when you attempt to invite a Felforged player and have a challenge count/tier mismatch is now also sent as a notification.
The error message given when you attempt to invite a Felforged player and have a challenge count/tier mismatch is now in red text.

Greatly increased the verbosity of the error messages given when you attempt to invite a Felforged player and have a challenge count/tier mismatch, including information about how many more or less of a challenge of a given tier you need in order to group with that player.
You can now get Quest Kill credit and experience while in Respite. This will prevent downtime after an honorable combat fight.

Jin'do's Delusion of Jin'do is no longer a curse and can no longer be dispelled.
